headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2021: The Young Bucks vs. Kingston & Penta settled things in a Street Fight match, headlining the show on Dynamite, rated 7.49 ? a well-worked match in a hard-hitting tag team clash ? part of that year's Road Rager '21.
Flash back to 2023, when Bill & Cage vs. Beretta & Sydal met in a Tournament Match, in the night's main event on Rampage, rated 7.46 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle.
It was 2021 when Andrade El Idolo touched down in AEW for the first time against Matt Sydal, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.33.

secondaries.text: 2023 brought us this moment: Jarrett & Hardy stepped through the curtain for the first time as a team, appearing on Rampage, rated 5.32.
It was 2021 when FTR & Wardlow touched down in AEW for the first time as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.21.
